sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 4x + 8$ in factoring polynomials completely, evaluate $f(5)$.
questions.target: Factoring polynomials completely

questions.q: Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 10x + 24 = 0$.
questions.target: Factoring polynomials completely
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 4$ and $x = 6$. Factoring $(x - 4)(x - 6) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 4$ and $x = 6$.

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 9$ in review: graphs and characteristics of quadratic functions, evaluate $f(2)$.
questions.target: Review: Graphs and characteristics of quadratic functions

questions.q: Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 5x + 4 = 0$.
questions.target: Review: Graphs and characteristics of quadratic functions
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 1$ and $x = 4$. Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 4) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 4$.

questions.q: A data set recorded for review: graphs and characteristics of quadratic functions consists of the four values $\{14, 18, 22, 28\}$. What is the arithmetic mean? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Review: Graphs and characteristics of quadratic functions
questions.answer: Final Answer: $20.5$. The sum is $14 + 18 + 22 + 28 = 82$, and dividing by $4$ gives $20.5$.
questions.explanation: The sum is $14 + 18 + 22 + 28 = 82$, and dividing by $4$ gives $20.5$.
